description: The Tamil Nadu Budget 2026-27 is having a greater emphasis on various sectors. The article provides an overview of the different budget allocations, schemes and targets announced by the state government.
body_lead: Synopsis: The Tamil Nadu Budget 2026-27 is having a greater emphasis on various sectors. The article provides an overview of the different budget allocations, schemes and targets announced by the state government. The Tamil Nadu government has announced its Budget for 2026-27, which will feature welfare measures, infrastructure development and technology-first solutions to improve the state's economic growth.
